svg.title: From spreadsheet cells to a typeset table
svg.desc: You supply a few spreadsheet cells: a header row, Group and Example value, then rows A 12, B 18, and C 24. Paste them into Tables Generator and copy the LaTeX: a tabular with columns lr, a \toprule, the header row, a \midrule, one row per line with & between cells and \\ at the end, and a \bottomrule. Paste that into the table example in the starter. The PDF shows the table with its caption above it, in bold: Table 2.1: Illustrative values for three example groups.
